tests.title: Power-on and self-test
tests.expected: On USB-C power the gadget starts, and every module passes its self-test as described in SOFTWARE_SETUP.md: button, display, light, microphone, speaker.

tests.title: Story, stop and volume
tests.expected: A tap plays a story through the speaker; a tap during a story stops it; the volume is comfortable at the listening position.

tests.title: Listening light and confirmation
tests.expected: The microphone opens only while the button is held, the light shows it is listening, and a new favourite is kept only after an explicit confirming tap.

tests.title: Memory after restart
tests.expected: A confirmed favourite is still there after unplugging and re-plugging power, and appears in a later story.

tests.title: Local API
tests.expected: From a phone or computer on the same network, GET /api/state returns the gadget's state and POST /api/action performs an action.

tests.title: Closed-case heat, power and retention
tests.expected: During a 30-minute session with the gadget closed there are no resets, no part becomes uncomfortably warm to touch, nothing rattles and no cable is pinched.

tests.title: Stability
tests.expected: The gadget stands level on its feet and does not tip or slide during normal use by a child under adult supervision.

tests.title: Firmware compiles
tests.expected: PlatformIO builds the delivered firmware for esp32-s3-devkitc-1.

tests.title: Firmware unit tests
tests.expected: The hardware-free unit tests of the firmware logic pass.

tests.title: Backplane design-rule check
tests.expected: The routed backplane has no design-rule errors (warnings and waived items excluded).

tests.title: CAD geometry checks
tests.expected: every CAD check passes: valid solids, no unintended collisions, closed print meshes

tests.title: Print slicing and parts list
tests.expected: every print part fits the bed and slices; every purchased row is complete

tests.title: Cross-stage consistency
tests.expected: CAD, parts list, wiring, firmware pins and electrical data agree
